# A reference character idle loop

[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

Turn an uploaded character into a small pixel sprite with a consistent idle cycle.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Source-checked 2026-09-10 · Not independently tested**

<a href="https://x.com/hahazwei/status/2097591465329488095"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRwkIsTaAAAdZHh?format=jpg&amp;name=small" width="560" alt="A reference character idle loop — @hahazwei source example" loading="lazy"></a>

Source example by [@hahazwei](https://x.com/hahazwei/status/2097591465329488095). This is the creator’s source result, not a verified output of the adapted prompt below.

## Prompt

### Step 1

```text
Using the character reference, draw 16 pixel-art idle frames in a 4-by-4 sheet on a 1024-by-1024 transparent canvas. Keep each character inside its 256-by-256 cell with a fixed baseline and generous padding. Use subtle breathing and one blink; preserve the character design.
```

### Step 2

```text
Split the sheet into individual PNG frames, align them, and export a transparent looping GIF plus the frames. Use nearest-neighbor resizing and inspect for clipping, position jumps, and false checkerboard transparency.
```

## Required inputs

- A character reference and tools that can split images and write GIF/PNG files.

## 中文

### 参考角色待机循环

把上传角色转成小型像素精灵，制作一致的待机循环。

**编辑改写 · 多步骤工作流 · 已核对原帖 · 尚未独立生图测试**

预览是原作者帖中的示例，并非本仓库使用下方提示词重新生成的结果。

### 提示词

步骤 1：

```text
以参考角色绘制 16 帧像素风待机动画，按 4×4 排列在 1024×1024 透明画布上。每格 256×256，固定基线并留足边距。使用轻微呼吸和一次眨眼，保持角色设计。
```

步骤 2：

```text
拆分为单帧 PNG 并对齐，导出透明循环 GIF 及各帧。缩放使用最近邻采样，检查裁切、位置跳动以及画出来的假透明棋盘格。
```

### 输入要求

- 角色参考图，以及能够拆图和写入 GIF/PNG 的工具。
